public_source_heads.source_scope: Windows raw-fd support and position semantics, exclusive-lock backend evolution, lower-bound selection

exact_continuation: Decide the Portalocker floor with an actual Windows lower-bound regression rather than API shape alone: pin 3.2.0 and run workspace_lease acquire->owner-write->release->reacquire plus cross-process exclusion and the new event authority. If clean, >=3.2 is defensible; if not, choose >=4.0, whose raw-fd byte-zero normalization is explicit. Then finish event authority preserving 0600 semantics plus candidate011 bytewise delimiter isolation before _maybe_roll(). Next enforce events.lock -> mission-view.lock for cross-platform reconciliation, then PlannerVerdict FOUND/ABSENT/UNKNOWN stable-snapshot semantics and stable-generation readers. Keep candidate008 durability and candidate005 transition_id provenance separate.

run_findings.candidate_012_dependency_floor: Argus declares portalocker>=3. Portalocker v3.0/v3.1 Windows are source-incompatible with existing Argus raw-int fd lock calls; v3.2 adds raw-int API support. Repository code search found no Portalocker shared-lock use and current direct sites use exclusive locking.
run_findings.candidate_012_floor_scope_revised: Treat >=3.2 as the checked raw-fd API floor, not yet a proven semantic floor. workspace_lease acquires via raw fd, writes owner JSON through the same fd, then unlocks it at a nonzero file position. Portalocker 3.2 does not normalize raw-fd position for its msvcrt operation; Portalocker 4.0+ does. A real Windows 3.2.0 regression must decide >=3.2 versus >=4.0.
run_findings.candidate_012_ci_gap: Current macOS/Windows portable workflow installs the current resolver and does not include tests/core/test_workspace_lease.py. A lower-bound Windows cell should explicitly include workspace_lease plus event-authority regressions.
run_findings.candidate_009_mode_preservation: After floor selection, event authority should preserve current os.open(...,0600) lock creation, retry only AlreadyLocked, propagate permanent acquire failures, and treat unlock after a committed canonical append as cleanup rather than a reason to duplicate the event.
run_findings.candidate_011_ordering_revised: Bytewise boundary isolation belongs before _maybe_roll(); otherwise a valid JSON tail missing only newline can be moved into .1 unterminated and iter_call_events will skip it. Pre-rotation repair is idempotent and preserves malformed bytes without truncation.
run_findings.candidate_007_windows_bootstrap_race: Mission View _locked remains fcntl-only cross-process; Windows reconciliation must share event authority with lock order events.lock -> mission-view.lock and avoid nested event-lock acquisition from writer projection.
run_findings.candidate_010_supervisor_contract: FOUND skips re-emit then acknowledges; ABSENT alone authorizes one re-emit after a complete stable scan; UNKNOWN leaves the outbox pending and returns PLAN_RETRY without Planner invocation.
run_findings.candidate_008_status: unchanged separate power-loss durability hypothesis; no power-loss incident reproduced
run_findings.candidate_005_transition_lineage_patch: optional existing Manager intent ID -> stage_history transition_id remains provenance-only and separate
run_findings.control_freeze: semantic work froze on note SHA a407c86e0039226a0eef0082fec10c3603befa9f control14/config6; later note heads were used only for write coordination and not adopted semantically
